failures.description: MMS issue was never resolved — agent escalated to a human without attempting the appropriate carrier-side fix (enable_roaming on line L1002). The customer's stated success criterion (an MMS sent successfully) was not met.

Customer was charged $4.00 for a 2 GB data refuel that did nothing to fix the symptom, because the underlying blocker is roaming being disabled on the line. Unwarranted billing harm (unnecessary charge) to the customer.

anomaly.description: Agent fetched L1001 then L1002 sequentially to map a phone number to a line, instead of inferring directly. Minor inefficiency. Non-causal observation; should not be read as an independent negative causal contributor to the final failure.

Toggling network mode, mobile data, airplane mode, APN reset, Wi-Fi calling, permissions — all standard device-side steps performed in lieu of the obvious account-side check (roaming flag on the line). Causal weight is captured by R1/R2/R6; this anomaly records the procedural pattern. Standardized anomaly note: this item is retained only as a non-causal inefficiency, noise, or side observation; if it is intended to explain a final failure, it should be modeled as an error instead.
